notes: «وغير، واحد» is «غير واحد», an unnamed co-transmitter in the first level; «- المعنى واحد -» is a gloss, left out
the closing «قال أبو عيسى» paragraph is the compiler's comment (it names Ayyub, Yunus b. Ubayd and Ali b. Zayd as saying al-Hasan did not hear from Abu Hurayra); it is not a route
the saying is Abu Hurayra's report of the Prophet's words; the Prophet is not a link
